firstPlayerRule: For the first game, agree on a method to select who chooses the starting player, such as a coin flip or dice roll. That person decides who takes the first turn.
clarifications: In later games of a match, the previous game's loser chooses the starter. After a draw, the same person who chose last time chooses again.
In a two-player game, the starting player skips their first draw step.
Special formats and card effects can override the ordinary opening procedure.
internalEvidence: The official rules page links the September 25, 2026 comprehensive rules. Rule 103.1 selects a chooser, not necessarily the starter; 103.8a gives the two-player draw-step exception.
